import numpy as np, requests, pandas as pd, networkx as nx
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def fetch(u):
    r=requests.get(u,timeout=180); r.raise_for_status(); return r.text
AF=fetch(requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q6FWH9",timeout=120).json()[0]["pdbUrl"])
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','MSE':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
VDW={'C':1.7,'N':1.55,'O':1.52,'S':1.8,'P':1.8,'':1.7,'H':1.2}
def parse(t,chain=None,lo=None,hi=None):
    A=[];H=[]
    for L in t.splitlines():
        r=L[:6]
        if r in("ATOM  ","HETATM"):
            ch=L[21]
            if chain and ch!=chain: continue
            try: i=int(L[22:26])
            except: continue
            rn=L[17:20].strip(); an=L[12:16].strip(); el=L[76:78].strip()
            x=np.array([float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),float(L[46:54])])
            if r=="ATOM  " or rn=="MSE":
                if lo is not None and not(lo<=i<=hi): continue
                A.append((an,rn,i,x,el))
            else: H.append((an,rn,i,x,el))
    return A,H
def cas(A):
    d={a[2]:(a[3],AA3[a[1]]) for a in A if a[0]=='CA' and a[1] in AA3}
    k=sorted(d); return k,np.array([d[i][0] for i in k]),"".join(d[i][1] for i in k)
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc=P.mean(0);qc=Q.mean(0);U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd((P-pc).T@(Q-qc))
    R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))])@U.T
    return R,qc-R@pc
def nw_fast(S,g=-0.6):
    n,m=S.shape; H=np.empty((n+1,m+1)); H[0,0]=0.; ar=np.arange(m+1,dtype=float); H[0,1:]=g*ar[1:]
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        H0=np.empty(m+1); H0[0]=g*i
        H0[1:]=np.maximum(H[i-1,:-1]+S[i-1],H[i-1,1:]+g)
        H[i]=np.maximum.accumulate(H0-g*ar)+g*ar
    i,j=n,m; pr=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        if abs(H[i,j]-(H[i-1,j-1]+S[i-1,j-1]))<1e-9: pr.append((i-1,j-1)); i-=1; j-=1
        elif abs(H[i,j]-(H[i-1,j]+g))<1e-9: i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return pr[::-1]
def tm_refine(X,Y,pr,Ln):
    if len(pr)<4: return 0.,None
    d0=max(1.24*(Ln-15)**(1/3)-1.8,.5); I=np.array([p[0] for p in pr]); J=np.array([p[1] for p in pr]); n=len(I)
    best=(0.,None)
    for L0 in sorted({4,max(4,n//8),max(4,n//4),max(4,n//2),n}):
        for s in range(0,n-L0+1,max(1,L0)):
            R,t=kabsch(X[I][s:s+L0],Y[J][s:s+L0])
            for _ in range(12):
                d=np.linalg.norm((X[I]@R.T+t)-Y[J],axis=1)
                v=float(np.sum(1/(1+(d/d0)**2))/Ln)
                if v>best[0]: best=(v,(R,t))
                c=max(d0,3.0); m=d<c
                while m.sum()<4 and c<12: c+=.5; m=d<c
                if m.sum()<4: break
                R,t=kabsch(X[I][m],Y[J][m])
    return best
def tmalign(a,b,nit=4):
    L1,L2=len(a),len(b); Ln=min(L1,L2); d0=max(1.24*(Ln-15)**(1/3)-1.8,.5); best=(0.,None,None)
    for fr in (1.0,0.6):
        w=max(20,int(Ln*fr))
        for off in range(-(L1-w),L2-w+1,max(1,w//2)):
            i0=max(0,-off); j0=max(0,off); n=min(L1-i0,L2-j0)
            if n<w: continue
            R,t=kabsch(a[i0:i0+n],b[j0:j0+n])
            for _ in range(nit):
                D=np.linalg.norm((a@R.T+t)[:,None,:]-b[None,:,:],axis=2)
                pr=nw_fast(1/(1+(D/d0)**2)); v,rt=tm_refine(a,b,pr,Ln)
                if v>best[0]: best=(v,pr,rt)
                if rt is None: break
                R,t=rt
    return best
def pocket(atoms,seed,grid=0.7,probe=1.4,bc=0.80,rad=13.0,msd=5.0):
    pts=np.array([a[3] for a in atoms]); rs=np.array([VDW.get(a[4],1.7) for a in atoms])
    s=np.linalg.norm(pts-seed,axis=1)<rad+8; pl=pts[s]; rl=rs[s]; al=[a for a,q in zip(atoms,s) if q]
    g=np.arange(-rad,rad+1e-9,grid); X,Y,Z=np.meshgrid(g,g,g,indexing='ij')
    P=np.stack([X.ravel(),Y.ravel(),Z.ravel()],1)+seed; P=P[np.linalg.norm(P-seed,axis=1)<=rad]
    tr=cKDTree(pl); free=np.ones(len(P),bool)
    for i,nb in enumerate(tr.query_ball_point(P,r=rl.max()+probe)):
        if nb and np.any(np.linalg.norm(pl[nb]-P[i],axis=1)<rl[nb]+probe): free[i]=False
    Pf=P[free]
    if not len(Pf): return 0.,seed,[]
    dirs=np.array([[i,j,k] for i in(-1,0,1) for j in(-1,0,1) for k in(-1,0,1) if (i,j,k)!=(0,0,0)],float)
    dirs/=np.linalg.norm(dirs,axis=1)[:,None]; st=np.arange(1.,15.,1.); bur=np.zeros(len(Pf))
    for d in dirs:
        dd,_=tr.query((Pf[:,None,:]+d[None,None,:]*st[None,:,None]).reshape(-1,3))
        bur+=(dd.reshape(len(Pf),len(st))<2.6).any(1)
    bur/=len(dirs); B=Pf[bur>=bc]
    if not len(B): return 0.,seed,[]
    G=nx.Graph(); G.add_nodes_from(range(len(B))); G.add_edges_from(cKDTree(B).query_pairs(r=grid*1.45))
    ds=np.linalg.norm(B-seed,axis=1); best=None
    for c in nx.connected_components(G):
        c=np.array(sorted(c))
        if ds[c].min()<=msd and (best is None or len(c)>len(best)): best=c
    if best is None: return 0.,seed,[]
    cav=B[best]; tc=cKDTree(cav)
    lin=sorted({(a[2],a[1]) for a in al if tc.query(a[3])[0]<4.5})
    return len(cav)*grid**3, cav.mean(0), lin
def coulomb(pt,atoms,eps=4.):
    q=[];p=[]
    for an,rn,ri,x,el in atoms:
        c=0.
        if rn=='ASP' and an in('OD1','OD2'): c=-.5
        elif rn=='GLU' and an in('OE1','OE2'): c=-.5
        elif rn=='LYS' and an=='NZ': c=1.
        elif rn=='ARG' and an in('NH1','NH2'): c=.5
        elif rn=='HIS' and an in('ND1','NE2'): c=.05
        if c: q.append(c);p.append(x)
    q=np.array(q);p=np.array(p);d=np.clip(np.linalg.norm(p-pt,axis=1),2.,None)
    return float(332.*np.sum(q/(eps*d*d)))
def sc(A,i,nm):
    for a in A:
        if a[2]==i and a[0] in nm: return a[3]
def axis_seed(A):
    cen=np.mean([a[3] for a in A if a[0]=='CA'],axis=0)
    tips=np.array([a[3] for a in A if (a[1],a[0]) in {('ASP','OD1'),('ASP','OD2'),('GLU','OE1'),('GLU','OE2'),('HIS','NE2'),('HIS','ND1')}])
    return tips[np.argsort(np.linalg.norm(tips-cen,axis=1))[:4]].mean(0)

PD={k:fetch(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{k}.pdb") for k in ["1DJX","2PZ0","1V8E","1PTG","1TIM"]}
aA,_=parse(AF,chain='A')
seedA=np.mean([sc(aA,149,('OD1','OD2')),sc(aA,232,('OD1','OD2')),sc(aA,176,('ND1',))],axis=0)
dom=[a for a in aA if 100<=a[2]<=411]
a1,_=parse(PD["1DJX"],chain='A',lo=290,hi=620); _,h1=parse(PD["1DJX"],chain='A')
ca1=[x[3] for x in h1 if x[0]=='CA' and x[1]=='CA'][0]
a2,h2=parse(PD["2PZ0"],chain='A'); ca2=[x[3] for x in h2 if x[0]=='CA' and x[1]=='CA'][0]
a3,h3=parse(PD["1V8E"],chain='A')
a4,h4=parse(PD["1PTG"],chain='A'); ins=np.array([x[3] for x in h4 if x[1]=='INS']).mean(0)
a5,_=parse(PD["1TIM"],chain='A')
jobs=[("AIM6\nQ6FWH9",dom,seedA,"query"),("PLC-delta1\n1DJX",a1,ca1,"PI-PLC"),
      ("GDPD\n2PZ0",a2,ca2,"GDPD"),("GDPD\n1V8E",a3,axis_seed(a3),"GDPD"),
      ("PI-PLC\n1PTG",a4,ins,"PI-PLC"),("TIM\n1TIM",a5,axis_seed(a5),"control")]
rows=[]
for n,at,sd,cl in jobs:
    v,c,l=pocket(at,sd); phi=coulomb(c,at)
    nd=sum(1 for i,r in l if AA3.get(r,'X') in 'DE'); nb=sum(1 for i,r in l if AA3.get(r,'X') in 'KR')
    rows.append(dict(name=n,cls=cl,vol=v,phi=phi,net=nb-nd,nlin=len(l)))
    print(n.replace("\n"," "),round(v,1),round(phi,2),nb-nd,len(l))
D=pd.DataFrame(rows)

# metal transplants
k1,X1,s1=cas(dom); RA={}
for a in aA: RA.setdefault(a[2],{})[a[0]]=(a[3],a[1])
TR={}
for lab,at,met in [("1DJX",a1,ca1),("2PZ0",a2,ca2)]:
    k2,X2,s2=cas(at); v,pr,(R,t)=tmalign(X1,X2)
    m=met@R.T.T+(-R.T@t) if False else met@(R.T).T+(-R.T@t)
    dd={}
    for i in sorted(RA):
        for an,(x,rn) in RA[i].items():
            if an in ('OD1','OD2','OE1','OE2','ND1','NE2','NZ','OG1','OH','ND2'):
                d=float(np.linalg.norm(x-m)); lab2=AA3.get(rn,'X')+str(i)
                if lab2 not in dd or d<dd[lab2]: dd[lab2]=d
    TR[lab]=(v,dd); print(lab,"TM",round(v,3))

keys=["E147","D149","D232","K234","Y129","T279","H176","N127","H126","R372"]
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15,4.6))
col={'query':'#c0392b','PI-PLC':'#2980b9','GDPD':'#27ae60','control':'#7f8c8d'}
ax[0].bar(range(len(D)),D.vol,color=[col[c] for c in D.cls])
ax[0].set_xticks(range(len(D))); ax[0].set_xticklabels(D.name,fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_ylabel("enclosed pocket volume (A$^3$)"); ax[0].set_title("A  Barrel-axis pocket size (1.4 A probe)",fontsize=10)
for i,v in enumerate(D.vol): ax[0].text(i,v+6,f"{v:.0f}",ha='center',fontsize=8)
for i,(x,y,n,c) in enumerate(zip(D.vol,D.phi,D.name,D.cls)):
    ax[1].scatter(x,y,s=110,color=col[c],edgecolor='k',zorder=3)
    ax[1].annotate(n.replace("\n"," "),(x,y),textcoords="offset points",xytext=(7,5),fontsize=8)
ax[1].axhline(0,color='k',lw=.6); ax[1].set_xlabel("pocket volume (A$^3$)")
ax[1].set_ylabel("Coulomb potential at pocket centre\n(kcal mol$^{-1}$ e$^{-1}$, eps = 4r)")
ax[1].set_title("B  Size and charge separate GDPD from PI-PLC sites",fontsize=10)
w=0.38; xs=np.arange(len(keys))
for o,(lab,cl) in enumerate([("1DJX",'#2980b9'),("2PZ0",'#27ae60')]):
    vals=[TR[lab][1].get(k,np.nan) for k in keys]
    ax[2].bar(xs+(o-0.5)*w,vals,w,color=cl,label=f"Ca$^{{2+}}$ from {lab} (TM {TR[lab][0]:.2f})")
ax[2].axhline(2.8,ls='--',color='k',lw=.8); ax[2].text(len(keys)-0.5,2.95,"direct coordination",ha='right',fontsize=8)
ax[2].set_xticks(xs); ax[2].set_xticklabels(keys,rotation=45,fontsize=9)
ax[2].set_ylabel("distance to transplanted Ca$^{2+}$ (A)")
ax[2].set_title("C  Two independent superpositions agree on E147/D149/D232",fontsize=10)
ax[2].legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print(D.to_string(index=False))
for lab in TR: print(lab, {k:round(TR[lab][1].get(k,np.nan),2) for k in keys})
